articles.summary: Poplar Bluff, Missouri, Oct. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Southern Missouri Bancorp, Inc. (“Company”) (NASDAQ: SMBC), the parent corporation of Southern Bank (“Bank”), today announced preliminary net income for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 of $15.7 million, an increase of $3.2 million or 25.6%, as compared to the same period of the prior fiscal year.
